name: Sang Pewaris
overview: Ali was told by Haji Mahfuz that he is the heir to Tunku Ahmad and Tunku Kamariah’s wealth and is requested to come home. He is actually their long-missing child. He also has a twin brother. However, Ali planned to disguise as a gardener first to get to know his family better. There, he fell in love with Zara, the family’s adopted daughter. But he then found out that the person he trusted the most is the real enemy.
